rules.grid: one cell per row and condition from the panels' record <out>/<body>/eval/<row>/<behavior>/<condition>.json: 'pass' or 'FAIL' (panels.PASS_RULE: 20/20 survive and at least 17/20 succeed) or 'unjudged' (fewer episodes, or an episode that failed to run), then survived,succeeded of the episodes and their one-sided 95 % Clopper-Pearson lower bounds (panels.LCB_RULE), as the record holds them; 'not run' if no record exists, 'no stance' if the floor has no settled stance for the body (panels.NOT_RUN_RULE: a result, not a missing record), 'n/a' where the row does not run (R0 and R1 run the hard floor only); a condition is gated or reported per row (panels.GATING_RULE: decision 23 reports the carpet walk for R0-R2); a failing record's label (panels.FAILURE_LABEL_RULE) is listed under the table
rules.flags: a cell is flagged interim ('*') when its record is not judged (fewer than 20 episodes or an episode that failed to run), its falls wait for decision 20's attribution (eval --attribute: R2 and R3 only, panels.ATTRIBUTED; the falls of R0, R1 and R4 are not attributed by design, which is final and not flagged), its key's panel sources differ from the sources read now (panels.PANEL_SOURCES_RULE: made by other code), or its row is a policy row (R3, R4) whose checkpoint is not final: final when the run's run.json holds a final judged checkpoint (train.JUDGED_RULE, 'judge --final' or every run at its budget) at the step count the record names (policy_rows.CHECKPOINT_SELECTION_RULE: the record's key names the checkpoint by its steps and files' sha256, not by whether it was final); the cell names the checkpoint's steps
rules.verdicts: per condition, panels.verdict on each controller's two seeds' records (panels.VERDICT_ROWS: R2 from R2/42 and R2/43, R3 from R3/42 and R3/43; panels.VERDICT_RULE), 'not run' when neither record exists; the counts are over the conditions gated for the controller's rows; the controller the grid's verdict column shows is panels.verdict_controller's (R3 once its records exist, else R2, interim), except that a body whose R3 is judged with R2 (train.R2_JUDGED_RULE: seed 42 failed G6c, plan section 3 step 7, or FIX_RULE stopped one of its R3 runs, decision 32) shows R2's, flagged, and its R3 column reads 'not judged'; until seed 42 reaches G6c the note says 'G6c not reached'; R4 trains one seed (decisions 3 and 28), so its verdict is policy_rows.R4_VERDICT_RULE's on R4/42's record (panels.verdict with 'shown' read as 'provisional': at most provisional; falls, never attributed for R4, read as a settled 'fails by falls'; 'not run' when no record exists), counted over the conditions gated for R4/42, and its records' results on those conditions are counted beside
rules.provenance: under the grid, one line per row with records: the controller its records name (panels.ROWS_RULE: R0 feedforward and PD; R1 the body-level G5 selection; R2/s CMA-ES seed s's G5 selection; policy_rows.POLICY_ROWS_RULE: R3/s the body-level selection plus PPO seed s's residual policy, R4/s PPO seed s's policy-only policy) and, for a policy row, each checkpoint its records ran with final or provisional (FLAGS_RULE)
rules.looks: per row and walk or carpet walk with a record: panels.LOOK_RULE's readings over the episodes' judged windows (reported, not gated: plan section 4, decision 9): sway, the mean of the episodes' mean per-stride peak to peak and the largest of their largest, / H, against BEHAVIOR_SPEC's 0.12 H; head (neck_pitch) and tail (tail_yaw) amplitude, the mean and range over the episodes, and how many lie in BEHAVIOR_SPEC's band (head 0.05-0.15 rad, tail 0.10-0.20 rad); episodes that fell before their window have no reading
rules.ledger: per margin and search (ledger.RULES), each ledger row's record <out>/<body>/sweeps/<row>/<margin>.json: the threshold on success ('works': the last value at which no seed falls or fails a term it passed at nominal, ledger.WORKS_RULE) and on survival ('survives'), each with the nearest value that fails and the label at it (ledger.LABEL_RULE, ledger.LIFT_RULE), or 'fails at nominal', 'works across the interval' (to its far end), 'not run'; points show works (and outright) and survives; the trunk-mass rows the whole robot's mass change beside the factor (ledger.MASS_RULE); plan section 5's Stage 0 values beside (ledger.STAGE0_RULE: the drives' with the value the ledger's own limit compares); a record is flagged '*' when its search is not finished, its key names other ledger sources than ledger.py now (ledger.SOURCES_RULE), it was made on other panel sources or key context than now, or (a tracker row) its panel keys differ from the ones computed now, or when a search fails at nominal on a condition the panels' 20-seed record passes; a policy row's results (R3/42) name the checkpoints its records ran, listed under the table and marked provisional when one is not final (FLAGS_RULE)
rules.ppo: per run (R3 seeds 42 and 43, R4 seed 42) its run.json: status, env steps trained of the budget (train.BUDGET_RULE), the last checkpoint, the judged checkpoint (train.JUDGED_RULE: steps, final or provisional; train.judged_checkpoint's current value marked 'not yet recorded' when run.json holds none), G6a (zero residual identical; env steps per wall second against 600), G6b, G6b after the one fix and G6c (train.G6_RULE, train.FIX_RULE: at what step, pass, the monitor's mean survival and the conditions R3 beats R2 on), each FAIL with the plan's consequence (G6a: the steps cut equally, decision 26; G6b: make one fix, then stop, decision 32; G6c: skip seed 43 and judge with R2), the job-hours of its sessions (the sum of their wall seconds, finished or to run.json's last write) and run.json's last write, a run whose status is 'running' marked 'stopped?' when run.json has not been written for 3 checkpoint intervals at the run's own rate (its last session's steps over that session's time to the last write; else its first rollouts' rate) and at least 60 min: run.json is written at checkpoints, not at every rollout; per body the elapsed wall hours, the union of every run's session intervals (plan section 6: wall clock per body; the runs share the cores, so their job-hours overlap)
rules.tune: tune.json: per CMA-ES seed the fit's status, evaluations and final sigma, the candidate G5 selected and its validation counts per condition (successes, survived of 20), the seed's G5 pass and label, the body's G5 and the body-level selection (env.GAINS_RULE: the CMA-ES seed R1 and R3 use)
rules.cost: core-hours per step from the records: prepare (refs.json and transitions.json seconds: wall, one process), gates (gates.json G1-G4 seconds: wall, one process), the fit (each seed's cma.json sessions, end - start x workers; evals.jsonl's evaluation wall seconds beside), G5 (tune.json seconds; its worker count is not recorded: one process assumed, a lower bound), PPO (run.json throughput: each finished session's CPU seconds; a session still running has no total yet: its wall to the record's last write x its first rollouts' CPU per wall second, an estimate; its wall hours the elapsed union of the sessions, its job-hours beside), the panels (each record's episode wall seconds and its attribution's: one process per episode, an upper bound on CPU) and the ledger (the CPU seconds of each evaluation once, by its key: an evaluation several margins share is in each of their records); core-hours are CPU hours where recorded, else wall hours x processes
